checkpoints.missing: The edge goes to graph.json / the slice only. issue/hypotheses.js turns only hook-same-priority and graph.problems into hypotheses, so it is never ranked or reported as a cause.

checkpoints.title: Duplicate REST route

checkpoints.missing: Routes built at run time (dynamic) are not compared. Same clue rule for third-party pairs.

checkpoints.title: Duplicate AJAX action

checkpoints.title: Duplicate option key

checkpoints.missing: Issue mode trusts removals only from syntax-tree components (custom, theme, evidence-named); closures and dynamic callbacks are never matched. Classic matches plain functions and Class::method only.
